action.add_row_failed: Could not add the row to {table}.
action.table_not_found: Table "{table}" not found in this base.
action.waiting_attach: Waiting for your automation to attach it…

automation.add_conditions: add both conditions — Product reference and Document reference are not empty
automation.add_link_action: add the “Add links” action linking {source} to {target}
automation.conditions_required: both not-empty conditions (Product reference and Document reference) are required
automation.extra_conditions: keep only the two conditions asked for — Product reference and Document reference are not empty; any other keeps some rows from triggering the rule
automation.extra_link_match: your “Add links” action from {source} to {target} matches on more than that one pair of columns: keep only that match, or some rows won’t be linked
automation.link_missing_for: the “Add links” action for {source} → {target} is missing
automation.no_new_rule: no NEW automation rule yet — add one, name it, and save it
automation.no_rule: no automation rule yet — add one, name it, and save it
automation.rule_gone: the rule you created is gone — create it again
automation.wrong_table_pinned: your rule doesn’t trigger on "{table}" yet
automation.wrong_condition: the condition on {column} must check that the column is not empty
automation.wrong_trigger: the trigger isn’t “When a row is added”

colleague.already_set: {row} is already {values} — nothing to change. Put the value back first, then run this again.
colleague.base_bell_failed: Could not read her notifications in this base ({status}).
colleague.base_token_failed: Could not get a base token for her ({status}).
colleague.cannot_open: She cannot open this base — check the token, and that the base is still shared with her.
colleague.checking_landed: Checking that her change reached the base…
colleague.connect_failed: Could not connect to the base as her — her change was not made. Try again in a moment.
colleague.no_table_named: No table named {table} in this base.
colleague.no_token_step2: No colleague token yet — the course asks for it in Step 2.
colleague.not_flushed: The change was made locally but never reached the server — the store never flushed it. Check that her token is valid and that the socket connected.
colleague.not_landed: Her change was sent but does not show in the base. Nothing else was done — try again.
colleague.table_not_found: Table "{table}" not found in the base she sees.

colleague_setup.is_this_her: Is this your colleague, and not you? If you recognize yourself here, the plugin would act in your own name for the rest of the course.
colleague_setup.rejected: SeaTable did not accept that token. Check that you copied it whole, from your colleague's Personal settings page, and that it is for this server.
colleague_setup.storage_note: The token is saved with the plugin, inside this base — so it is still here next time, on any machine. Anyone you share the base with can read it there, which is why this second account is one you make for the course and use nowhere else.
colleague_setup.stored_rejected: The stored token is no longer accepted. Paste it again.

colleague_window.access_through_group: Malika can already open {base} through a group. Remove her from that group to follow this step: otherwise sharing and revoking change nothing for her.
colleague_window.caption_base: What Malika sees in her own window, in this base
colleague_window.caption_home: What Malika sees on her own home page

entry.comment: Added a new comment for record named {row}.
entry.shared_base: {who} has shared a base named {base} to you.

colleague_window.no_access: {base} is not shared with her, so she cannot open it — and the companion cannot act on her behalf in it until you share it with her again.
colleague_window.shared_failed: Could not read her shared bases.
colleague_window.token_missing: Her token is missing or no longer accepted — go back to the setup step.

controls.expand_to_follow: Expand the course to follow this step.

automation.just_check: I built it — just check it
automation.stage_complete: Stage complete — on to the next.

burst.done: ✅ Done — {count} changes, so {count} requests to read at the other end.

colleague.configured: Your colleague’s account is set up.
colleague.edit: Let your colleague make the change
colleague.failed: Could not make the change as the colleague.
colleague.side_writes: Malika updates a few other customers…
colleague.written: ✅ Written on row {row}. Now open the base log and read the entry: does it name the row, does it carry her name, and does its menu offer Restore?

feedback.missing: ⚠️ Couldn't find {what} in the base. Check that the base matches the exercise.

course.handoff_default: The next step continues on the website ↩

intro.external: 📌 This course is currently not supported by the plugin, but you can follow it on {link}.
intro.finalizing: 🚧 This course is still being finalized: some of its content may change.
intro.missing: 📌 This base’s structure doesn’t seem to match this course. Open the course’s base before you start — the plugin’s steps read and write there.

lines.attached: ✅ {written}, and {reference} put on your document so your rule can attach them.
lines.no_document: ⚠️ {written} — but no document carries {reference}, so your rule has nothing to attach them to. Create the delivery note first, then write the lines again.
lines.written_replacing_one: {count} line written, replacing the {removed} the extraction produced
lines.written_replacing_other: {count} lines written, replacing the {removed} the extraction produced

rewind.done_one: ✅ {count} line and the document removed. Now receive the delivery again from the app.
rewind.done_other: ✅ {count} lines and the document removed. Now receive the delivery again from the app.
rewind.done_stock_one: ✅ {count} line and the document removed, stock put back. Now receive the delivery again from the app.
rewind.done_stock_other: ✅ {count} lines and the document removed, stock put back. Now receive the delivery again from the app.
rewind.nothing: ✅ Nothing left to remove — that delivery is already out of your base. Receive it again from the app.

seed.not_linked: ⚠️ The delivery is there, but its line has not been linked yet — check the automation you built in Step 2, then run your rule.
seed.note_ready: ✅ The delivery note is in your base, with no lines and no file. Push one from the API reference, then verify.
seed.short_ready: ✅ A short delivery is waiting. Run your rule, then verify.

watch.added: Added {count} lines. Waiting for your automation…
watch.failed: Could not add the delivery lines.
watch.missing_targets: ⚠️ Nothing was added: this base lacks what the delivery lines link to — {list}. Put it back (or re-import the course’s base), then press {look_again}.
watch.not_found: The new lines could not be found after writing them.
watch.stalled: ⏳ {linked}/{total} lines linked — {missing} still empty. Automations can take a moment; give it a few seconds and look again. If it stays empty, check your rule's conditions and its Add links actions.
watch.waiting: Waiting for your automation… {linked}/{total} lines linked.
watch.wrong_table: You’re looking at “{current}”. Open the “{table}” table so you can watch the lines land — then add them.

course.wrong_table: You’re looking at “{current}”. Open “{table}” first, or you will miss what happens.
course.wrong_view: Open the “{view}” view of “{table}” first — in this one the change happens off-screen and you will miss it.

courses.checkpoints_caption: Plugin checkpoints — follow the rest of the course on the website
courses.exercise_title: Exercise — the panel shrinks so you can work in your base

oplog.not_from_api: the {noun} is there, but it did not come in through the API
oplog.not_set_by_automation: no automation has set {column} on a matching {table} row yet
oplog.prepared_row_gone: the {table} row prepared for this exercise is gone
oplog.read_failed: could not read the activity log

ui_check.lower_right: drag the toolbar into the lower-right quarter of the screen
ui_check.read_failed: could not read the plugin window
ui_check.resize: drag the grip at the top center of the panel up or down first
ui_check.shrink: shrink the plugin to the toolbar first (the shrink icon, top-right)
